d:
Ostreliya men ek prakar ke mendhak ko rokne ke lie lakhon dolar kharch karne par rahe hain. is mendhak ka nam hai ken tod, joki ek prakar ka zahrila mendhak hai. vestarn ostreliya ke pilbara kshetr men riyo tinto nam ki kanpni isi mendhak ko rokne ki koshish kar rahi hai. riyo tinto kanpni parth sthit kartin yunivarsiti aur dusre sansthanon ke sath milkar ken tod ko rokne ke lie 28 miliyan ostreliyaee dolar yani lagbhag 185 karor rupye kharch karegi.
